newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel slowed by supply, Med shipping shortage.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel slowed by supply, Med shipping shortage.

text.p: High freight and poor supply kept a lid on NWE jet fuel business on Wednesday, traders said.
February IPE gas oil closed down $0.50 at $203.25 a tonne, influence by technical selling of NYMEX crude oil futures.
A barge of 1,000 tonnes traded at Feb IPE +$29 fob ARA, around $1/2 easier, traders said. But cargoes were dull, with high Med freight curbing movements into the north.
Cargoes were notionally at Feb IPE +$33 cif NWE and around fob Med high quotes flat in the Med. Traders reported scattered buying interest into Scandinavia for good cold properties.
